words.gloss: that which is difficult to bear

literal: Enduring the difficult, removing the distressful disease, enduring the separation, staying behind and living afterwards, many are they.
translation: There are many who can endure what is hard to bear, dispel the painful disease of grief, tolerate separation, and continue to live after their lover has departed.
modern: தாங்குவதற்கு அரியதைத் தாங்கி, துன்பம் தரும் நோயை நீக்கி, பிரிவைப் பொறுத்துக் கொண்டு, காதலர் சென்ற பிறகு உயிர்வாழும் மனிதர்கள் பலர் இருக்கிறார்கள்.
explanation: In this verse, the speaker highlights the extreme difficulty of surviving a lover's departure. She observes that there are many people who possess the strength to bear what is unbearable, overcome the painful sickness of longing, and continue living after separation. By pointing out that 'many' can survive this ordeal, she subtly reveals her own inability to do so, suggesting that for her, separation is a mortal blow.
